Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000211": As of 2025-02-12, Marcus has the Boreal pager.  (about: Boreal team, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000011": As of 2025-01-07, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000061": The Boreal team owns the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000055": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down, the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhooks service relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down, the webhooks service is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000163": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000222": The notifier's previous flat one-second retry hammered the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000220" [decision]: As of 2025-02-21, the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000172" [decision]: After INC-2025-004, the notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000167": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004, broker)
- memory_id "1000232": As of 2025-02-27, Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000240": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000132": The job scheduler lives with the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000204": As of 2025-02-12, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman)
- memory_id "1000160" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000256": As of 2025-03-07, the billing API lives with the Ember team.  (about: billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000101": As of 2025-01-14, Oskar takes the first Ember team on-call shift of the year.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000097": As of 2025-01-13, the first on-call rotation for the Dune team goes to Farah.  (about: Farah, Dune team)
Existing entity names: Boreal team, Marcus, Lena, ledger service, notifier, the bus, webhook dispatcher, INC-2025-004, push provider, broker, Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder, Ember team, job scheduler, Atlas team, Priya Raman, billing API, Oskar, Farah, Dune team
